text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian has won the autumn Tenno Sho. Having surpassed Oguri Cap, our next goal is the second race of the Senior Autumn Triple Crown—the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Around the same time, word of Symboli Rudolf joining the Japan Cup spreads. No doubt, she's planning to engage Narita Brian head on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, Narita Brian will be able to race the Emperor… She is so filled with determination that she can only quietly utter "I want to win."
